lines.say: Your building’s lift has four rules after midnight. Break one and you don’t arrive.
Rule one. Always face the door.
Rule two. If someone behind you says your name, don’t answer.
Rule three. If it stops between floors, wait. Do not press anything.
Rule four. Your building has nine floors. If the lift shows ten, get out. Whatever is there is kinder.
Which rule would you break? Write it in the comments.
